direction: Contemporary Mario Party menu pictograms with softly shaded Brighton/Twila character emblem.

images.name: picture
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one production menu icon for a modern Mario Party 6 native-port settings screen.
Image 1 is the current icon to revise. Image 2 is a Mario Party Superstars menu reference; match the treatment of its illustrated menu icons, NOT its text, backdrop, characters or layout.
Primary request: redraw the subject as a clean, simple contemporary Mario Party menu pictogram: crisp flat colored shapes, minimal two-tone dimensional shading, a thin WHITE outer separation line. Smooth confident contours, large readable features, bright Nintendo party colors. No brown/black outline around every shape, no cream sticker backing, no hand-painted texture, no faceted papercraft, no thick bevels, no shiny plastic, no 3D toy rendering. The result should sit naturally alongside the Superstars menu's illustrated star, clock and Toad icons.
Composition: ONE centered compact icon on a square genuinely transparent background; fully inside canvas with 10% clear padding all around. Designed to be readable at 40px. No labels, text, watermark, badge panel, solid background, ground shadow, decorative sparkles, or unrelated props.
Subject: Keep a gold picture frame with a small simple star crest and blue-sky/green-treetop scene. Simplify the frame into a slim golden band with gently rounded corners, NO bulky round corner bolts. The inside is just a sky-blue field, two big green treetop shapes and one white cloud. Use very few lines and just one darker gold side for slight depth.

images.name: day-night
images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: modern Mario Party settings-header character emblem.
Image 1 is the current emblem to restyle. Image 2 is the actual Brighton character design. Image 3 is the actual Twila character design. Preserve their identities exactly, not generic sun/moon emoji.
Create a modern Nintendo-style softly shaded 3D character-head emblem, Brighton on the left foreground and Twila just behind at the right, both heads fully readable. Heads ONLY, no bodies, hands or props.
Brighton: round face sharply split yellow/orange-red along his angular nose, opposing orange-red/yellow plain oval eyes, pointed alternating red/yellow sun rays, simple closed smile. Twila: slim green/yellow crescent face, sharp split colors, opposite-colored plain oval eyes and a simple closed smile; NOT a blue moon, sleepy emoji or generic crescent.
Art: contemporary Super Mario Party/Jamboree character-menu rendering. Precisely shaped, lively proportions, soft diffuse studio light, smooth satin surfaces with very restrained highlights and natural dimensional shading. No waxy balloon-toy gloss, huge black sparkling eyes, teeth, tongue, blush, illustrated outlines, cream sticker edge, papercraft facets, painterly texture or dark drop shadow. Sharper sun rays and distinctive split-color faces provide the personality.
One compact emblem with 10% transparent margin on all sides, genuine transparent background, entire silhouette visible, square canvas, legible at 72px. No lettering, logo or additional decorations.
